title: Roasted Banh Mi Potatoes
description: A delicious fusion of Vietnamese and roasted flavors, this dish combines the crunch of roasted potatoes with the softness of banh mi.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: any variety, peeled and cut into wedges

instructions: Toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon of the vietnamese chili sauce and a pinch of salt.
Spread the potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are roasting, toast the banh mi slices by grilling or toasting in a toaster.
In a small bowl, mix together the lovely leaves, chopped bot, and remaining 1 tablespoon of vietnamese chili sauce.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Assemble the banh mi by spreading a layer of the lovely mixture on each toasted slice, followed by a few pieces of the roasted potatoes.
